frameworks.name: AIDA Framework
frameworks.description: Attention, Interest, Desire, Action - guides potential customers through decision-making
steps: Attention: Grab with strong opening, headline, or surprising fact
Interest: Provide relevant information, benefits, or compelling story
Desire: Highlight uniqueness with emotional appeals, testimonials, features
Action: Clear CTA - Buy Now, Sign Up, Learn More

frameworks.name: Pain-Agitate-Solution
frameworks.description: Identify problem (Pain), amplify it (Agitate), provide solution
frameworks.use: Blog posts, landing pages, sales emails

frameworks.name: Features-Advantages-Benefits
frameworks.description: Emphasize features, advantages they provide, and benefits to customer

principles.name: Start with Why
principles.description: Connect message to deeper purpose. Communicate the reason behind the product to build trust and inspire loyalty.

principles.name: Educational Content
principles.description: Provide value by teaching something useful. Positions brand as helpful authority, builds trust, encourages engagement.

principles.name: Create Urgency
principles.description: Motivate immediate action through scarcity or time sensitivity. Competition features add natural urgency - the sooner students start, the more XP they gain.

principles.name: Relatability
principles.description: People engage with content reflecting their experiences. Relate complex concepts to things audience understands (e.g., gamification to football/sports).

principles.name: Storytelling
principles.description: Transform information into engaging narrative. Stories make messages relatable and memorable by appealing to emotions.

principles.name: Repetition
principles.description: Reinforces message, builds recognition and trust. Repeat core messages across channels and formats.

principles.name: Agreement Ladder
principles.description: Get small agreements early to increase likelihood of larger agreements later. Start with easy, relatable questions.

principles.name: Social Proof
principles.description: Use testimonials, reviews, endorsements to build credibility. Real experiences reduce skepticism.

contentMix: Wide target posts + niche audience posts
